title: Use of animal models to understand CNS neuroimmunology — guidance from the International Society for Neuroimmunology White Paper Task Force
title_zh: 利用动物模型了解中枢神经系统神经免疫学——国际神经免疫学会白皮书工作组指南
abstract: Neuroimmunology is a rapidly expanding field in which many breakthroughs have been fuelled by studies in animal models that capture aspects of human neurological disease. However, the variety of animal models available, with their relative merits and drawbacks, is not well documented in the literature, posing a hurdle for scientists who are venturing into the world of neuroimmunology. Moreover, nuances between animal models, their utility for studying neuroimmunological processes and the variables that affect their associated clinical and pathological outcomes can affect the reproducibility and clinical relevance of findings at the preclinical stage. In this Review, the International Society of Neuroimmunology White Paper Task Force describes animal models that can be used to study neuroimmunological aspects of neurological disease and the intrinsic and extrinsic factors that affect readouts from these models. We provide guidance on how to manipulate these factors to gain insight into neuroimmunology and to control them for improved reproducibility. We also consider the advantages and limitations of available tools, including robust genetic systems, neuroimmunological imaging, functional readouts and omics-based cell profiling. Finally, we discuss how animal models have advanced drug development to treat neuroimmunological diseases and how the same principles can provide insight into a variety of neurological disorders. We aim to provide guidance on how to optimize the use of animal models to gain insight into neuroimmunological mechanisms and support the preclinical drug discovery pipeline. Neuroimmunology breakthroughs have been fuelled by studies in animal models. In this Review, the International Society of Neuroimmunology White Paper Task Force describes animal models that can be used to study neuroimmunological aspects of neurological disease and provide guidance on how to optimize use of animal models to gain insight into neuroimmunological mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 神经免疫学是一个快速发展的领域，许多突破都依赖于捕捉人类神经系统疾病方面的动物模型研究。然而，文献中并未很好地记录可用的动物模型及其相对优劣，这给进入神经免疫学领域的科学家带来了障碍。此外，动物模型之间的细微差别、它们研究神经免疫学过程的实用性以及影响其临床和病理结果的变量，可能会影响预临床阶段发现的可重复性和临床相关性。在这篇综述中，国际神经免疫学会白皮书工作组描述了可用于研究神经系统疾病神经免疫学方面的动物模型，以及这些模型内在和外在因素对读数的影响。我们提供了如何操纵这些因素以深入了解神经免疫学并为提高可重复性而对其进行控制的指南。同时，我们还考虑了现有工具的优势和局限性，包括健壮的遗传系统、神经免疫学成像、功能读数和基于组学的细胞谱型分析。最后，我们讨论了动物模型如何推进治疗神经免疫学疾病的药物开发，以及相同的原则如何为各种神经系统疾病提供见解。我们旨在提供指南，以优化动物模型的使用，深入了解神经免疫学机制并支持预临床药物发现管线。神经免疫学突破依赖于动物模型研究。在这篇综述中，国际神经免疫学会白皮书工作组描述了可用于研究神经系统疾病神经免疫学方面的动物模型，并提供了如何优化动物模型使用以深入了解神经免疫学机制的指南。
